states_storage.device_materialization: Per-sample slices are converted by the existing __getitem__ path; the full array remains a host uint8 ndarray.

storage_only.acceptance_gate: In one actual Trainer initialization, compare 64 deterministic window indices including first/last and multiple trajectory boundaries from eager ndarray and read-only states.npy mmap representations using the same default_collate and existing Normalizer; require raw equality for every field in the pinned WallSample._fields, normalized equality for states/actions/locations plus any normalized fields retained by the Normalizer, and unchanged Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG states. Do not iterate the training RandomSampler, repeat the Normalizer scan, or construct a second Trainer/model.
storage_only.formal_override_decision: Use native eager lazy_load=false after the 64-window raw/normalized six-field equality and unchanged RNG gate passed.
